title: 11 Up
tagline: Pairs that make 11. Clear the table.
blurb: Full 4×4 like the bar-top. A+10, 2+9, 3+8, 4+7, 5+6, or a matching face pair. Next Card fills a hole and costs. Clear the layout and more cards drop. Two rounds.

copy.playing: Tap two open cards that make 11, or two of the same face.
copy.full: Table full. Pair or take score.
